verdict.reasons: The image correctly identifies the white-and-blue cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll. The branding and text are authentic and clearly readable. The watermark is present and correct. The scene plausibly depicts an agricultural field with installed drip lines and parallel planting rows, which aligns with the article's topic of drip tape spacing. While there are minor visual imperfections—such as a somewhat abrupt join where the coiled tape strip transitions into the extended lateral line in the soil, and slight blurring of the fine print—these are advisory. The core product identity, commercial packaging, and technical context are fully intact and suitable for the article.

focused_physical_review.reason: clear_soil_gap is false because an installed black irrigation line runs directly against and immediately adjacent to the base of the package, preventing a broad uninterrupted soil gap around the footprint. line_touches_or_crosses_package is false because the black line approaches the outer edge but does not disappear underneath, emerge from, or cross the package carton. extra_loose_product_coil is true because a distinct, uninstalled loose black coil (roll) is sitting on the soil to the right of the required package, separate from the continuous installed lateral. package_has_protruding_strip is false because the white-and-blue carton is intact with no visibly protruding tape, strap, or ribbon tails.

acceptance_warnings: Independent physical condition not met: clear_soil_gap
Independent physical condition not met: extra_loose_product_coil
